global_events: Twenty current official Auction House August 2026 records were decided; fourteen selected and six fail-closed.
Seven full-direct and seven current indexed-direct official source upgrades were retained.
All retained candidates have future 17–25 August 2026 auction dates relative to 31 July 2026.
Seventeen representative exact-address repository searches returned zero indexed hits; exhaustive duplicate proof is not claimed.
2 Chapel Street was excluded because the official page alternates between Camborne and Cambourne.
Flat 4, 6 Falkner Street was excluded because the official address and description state different localities.
Flats 1 and 2, 11 Pendrill Street were excluded because the official summary and description conflict on bedroom configuration.
Apartment 6, 7 Tinker Brook Close was excluded because current header and embedded bidding panel conflict on price and dates.
Flat 8 Holt House was excluded because the current listing and retrievable direct page show different auction dates.
43 Main Street was excluded because current listing and direct page conflict on guide price and auction timing.
Seven retained candidates use full-direct pages and seven use current indexed-direct snapshots without unsupported expansion.
Indexed-direct candidates were not expanded beyond current official listing evidence.
Guide prices and ranges are auction indications, not valuations or achieved prices.
Publisher rent, tenancy, comparable-rent and investment wording was not independently underwritten.
Lease, title, charges, ground rent, service charge, balcony, parking, garage and common-part obligations remain legal-pack dependent.
Extension, conversion, commercial-unit and development wording was not converted into planning or lawful-use outcomes.
Disconnected services, renovation, measurements, furnishing and condition wording requires independent inspection.
Vacancy, prior letting, possession and occupational status require legal-pack confirmation.
Locality conflicts were excluded rather than silently normalized.
Current and stale bidding-state conflicts were excluded rather than merged.
No second runner, owner or task was created; continuation key was preserved.
Research was split into four bounded candidate groups while GitHub writes remained serial.
Automation 167 port-8012 DOM proof remains external and unresolved.
Public-host, parcel, geometry and final promotion remain blocked; no synthetic evidence was created.
